title: Correct earlier advice after a new personal fact

turns.say: 내일 아침 8시에 한라산 성판악 코스로 올라갈 건데 준비물 알려줘.

good_secretary: Revises its own earlier advice for a weak knee (poles, knee support, pacing, turnaround time, or a shorter course) and says what changed, instead of starting over generically. Mentions checking trail/entry rules if not verified.
